package planted

// PLANTED instances of the defect class fetchtags_guard_test.go's update guard catches: go-git
// fetch options that leave a ref-update decision to go-git. It MUST flag 11, 15 and 19, not 23.

import (
	gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
)

func plantedUnforced(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{Tags: gogit.NoTags})
}

func plantedForceFalse(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{Tags: gogit.NoTags, Force: false})
}

func plantedPrune(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{Tags: gogit.NoTags, Force: true, Prune: true})
}

func clean(r *gogit.Remote) error {
	return r.Fetch(&gogit.FetchOptions{Tags: gogit.NoTags, Force: true})
}
